uncited: Identify the intersection points of the view ray with the light volume.

*   **Shadow Map Inconsistencies:** If only front faces are rendered to the shadow map, or if distant occluders are excluded, artifacts appear.
*   **Temporal AA Jitter:** Temporal AA jitter causes flickering in down-sampled buffers.
*   **High-Frequency Occluders:** Performance drops at low angles due to dense occluders.
*   **Time Complexity:** Depends on the number of intervals (intersections with light volume) and the complexity of the light type.
